tenders.title: SELECTION OF Architects / Architectural Firms for providing architectural designs and services towards Development of Research Park and associated facilities at IIT Bhilai.
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks architectural firms for design and services for a Research Park at IIT Bhilai, including BIM modeling (Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD or equivalent) with clash detection features. The selected firm will also be responsible for sustainability assessment, quantity surveying, and cost estimation.
key_points: BIM modeling (LOD 350) and sustainability assessment required.
Proficiency in CAD, 3D visualization, and documentation tools is essential.
Service integration (internal and external) to be prepared and submitted in BIM/RIVET model with clash detection.
Minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 3.0 Crores in the last three financial years.
Hard copies of the technical bid (without financial bid) must be sent to IIT Bhilai.

tenders.title: Tender for Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of IoT-based Ultrasonic-type Digital water meters Confirming to ISO:4064-2014 for water supply lines to the additional Buildings at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy.
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks a vendor for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of IoT-based ultrasonic digital water meters. The scope includes enabling associated software for operation and maintenance, and potentially predictive maintenance of devices.
key_points: Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning of IoT-based ultrasonic digital water meters.
Similar work experience: three works each of value not less than 40% of estimated cost, or two works each of value not less than 60%, or one work of value not less than 80% in the last 7 years.
Delivery and installation within 45 days from the date of the supply order.

tenders.title: tender for procurement of the enterprise monitoring software (ems) solution and the ticketing tool to itec department with technical support for a period of 03 years.
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for the procurement of an Enterprise Monitoring Software (EMS) solution and a ticketing tool for the ITEC Department, including three years of technical support. The tender is related to asset management and IT-OT integration.
key_points: Procurement of Enterprise Monitoring Software (EMS) and ticketing tool.
Includes 3 years of technical support.
Due date is May 22, 2026.

tenders.title: Implementation of an Integrated Enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin Platform for Geo-analytics Property Tax Enhancement Asset Management and Urban Governance for Mysuru City.
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks a solution for implementing an integrated enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin platform for Mysuru City. The platform will be used for geo-analytics, property tax enhancement, asset management, and urban governance.
key_points: Implementation of an integrated Enterprise GIS and 3D Digital Twin platform.
Focus on geo-analytics, property tax enhancement, asset management, and urban governance.
Due Date: May 22, 2026.

tenders.title: Bids are invited for AR/VR Training Module Development total quantity : 1.
tenders.scope_summary: This tender invites bids for the development of an AR/VR training module. The scope includes creating immersive content and potentially integrating it with an LMS.
key_points: Development of AR/VR training module.
Total quantity: 1.
Due Date: May 20, 2026.

tenders.title: Provision of Drone Based Survey for Digital Twin Creation with the Integration of Satellite Data, Qty: 12 Km, (BOQ Item #1)
tenders.scope_summary: The India Government has published a tender for a drone-based survey to create a digital twin with integrated satellite data. The work involves surveying a quantity of 12 Km.
key_points: Drone-based survey for digital twin creation.
Integration of satellite data.
Quantity: 12 Km.
Closing on August 19, 2024.

tenders.title: Tender for conducting GPR Survey of Land at MDI Gurgaon Campus
tenders.scope_summary: Tenders are invited for conducting a GPR Survey of land at the MDI Gurgaon Campus to map the location, elevation, properties, and size of underground pipelines, cables, and other utilities. The work includes the preparation of underground utility maps in 2D/3D AutoCAD files and a 3D model of the utilities.
key_points: Conduct GPR survey to map underground utilities.
Preparation of 2D/3D AutoCAD files and 3D model of underground utilities.
Survey drawings at a scale of 1:500.
Validity of quotation: 90 days from the date of opening.
Last date for submission not specified in snippet, but published in May 2022.

tenders.title: Tender for supply, installation, testing and commissioning of remote diagnostic and predictive maintenance system in kanpur ghaziabad section of prayagraj division.
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of a remote diagnostic and predictive maintenance system in the Kanpur Ghaziabad section of the Prayagraj division. This system aims to enhance the maintenance capabilities within the railway infrastructure.
key_points: Supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of a remote diagnostic and predictive maintenance system.
Location: Kanpur Ghaziabad section of Prayagraj division.
Due date is May 22, 2026.
